description: The run cases of `cargo xtask parity script`: the form-free scripts of the 4.1.5q `Edit Scripts` folder (the 32 that use a form are covered by the port's form shim instead). A case names the game and the plugins to load (defaults below); `close_after` closes the GUI after the script, so `SaveChanged` writes the plugins it changed into the private data folder and their bytes are compared with the port's. A case with `build_refs` has the oracle build the reference information after loading (the script reads `ReferencedBy`); the port is told the same. A case's `answers` (issue #26) records the dialogs the script shows, in order, and both sides run with them (`control` and `repeat` drive a form control by control); a `variant` names a second case of the same script. Scripts classed interactive or form without answers are listed for completeness and deferred unless named with --script.

cases.note: the TPerlRegEx check of `parity script --script "Regex probe" --phase run`: the probe lives in `crates/xtask/oracle/scripts/probes` (the oracle's folder holds no such file), loads the empty master the harness writes and compares every line it adds to the log
